description: This file defines the SimpleMapProcessor class, which is part of the minilang package in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load, cache, and execute 'simple map' processors defined by XML configurations, typically used to process data maps according to XML-defined rules.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcessor
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for loading, caching, and executing 'simple map' processors based on XML definitions, used within the OFBiz minilang framework.

methods.name: getAllProcessors
methods.description: Reads an XML document from a URL, parses it to extract 'simple-map-processor' elements, and returns a map of processor names to MapProcessor objects.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves all processors defined in an XML resource, loading and caching the XML document if necessary, identified by resource name and class loader.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves all processors from a given XML URL, loading and caching if needed.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named SimpleMapProcessor identified by an XML resource, with given input map, results map, messages list, and locale, optionally using a specified class loader.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named SimpleMapProcessor identified by an XML URL, with given input map, results map, messages list, and locale, optionally using a specified class loader.
